meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析科学数据，检测异常与缺失，生成探索性报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有科学数据文件需要快速洞察特征与问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have scientific data files and need quick insights into characteristics and issues

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能自动识别200多种科学文件格式，分析其结构、内容、质量，并生成详细的Markdown报告，包含统计摘要、质量评估和后续分析建议。
howto.when: 当用户提供科学数据文件路径，或要求“探索”“分析”“总结”数据集时触发。也适用于询问文件适合什么分析的情况。

say.text: 分析这个fastq文件，看看序列质量如何。
say.note: Claude会读取文件，生成序列统计和质量报告。

say.text: 帮我探索这个CSV数据集，检查缺失值和异常值。
say.note: Claude会输出数据概览、统计信息和质量问题。

say.text: 检查这个ND2图像文件的元数据和维度。
say.note: Claude会提取图像尺寸、通道等元信息。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can auto-detect 200+ scientific file formats, analyze their structure, content, and quality, and generate detailed Markdown reports with statistical summaries, quality metrics, and downstream analysis recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a file path to a scientific data file, or asks to 'explore', 'analyze', or 'summarize' a dataset. Also for inquiries about suitable analyses.

say_en.text: Analyze this FASTQ file and report sequence quality.
say_en.note: Claude reads the file and generates a sequence stats and quality report.

say_en.text: Explore this CSV dataset for missing values and outliers.
say_en.note: Claude outputs data overview, statistics, and quality issues.

say_en.text: Check metadata and dimensions of this ND2 image file.
say_en.note: Claude extracts image dimensions, channels, etc.
